fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-01-17, the main gate of the complainant near Amudham Layout Residential Colony in Salem was defaced and partly broken. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-01-14 at approximately 21:55. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, residential colony, CCTV, night
